description: DMIS mobile/web GraphQL document allowlist. Clients may send the full document (hash must match when mode=document) or Apollo-style extensions.persistedQuery.sha256Hash for lookup.

operations.name: MobileHome
operations.document: query MobileHome($page: Int, $iLimit: Int, $nLimit: Int, $before: ID) { mobileHome(incidentPage: $page, incidentLimit: $iLimit, notificationLimit: $nLimit, notificationBeforeId: $before) { generatedAt syncCursor syncScopeKey viewer { id name email roles permissions } incidents { items { id title status workflowStatus workflowStatusLabel severity hazardName districtName regionName locationDescription reportedAt allocationsCount tasksCount responseActive } currentPage lastPage total } notifications { items { id type title message link entityType entityId severity read createdAt category categoryLabel categoryIcon } unreadCount latestId hasMore nextBeforeId } } }

operations.name: MobileSync
operations.document: subscription MobileSync($after: ID!) { mobileSync(afterSequence: $after) { sequence occurredAt } }

operations.name: IncidentWorkspace
operations.document: query IncidentWorkspace($id: ID!) { incidentWorkspace(id: $id) { generatedAt syncCursor syncScopeKey incident { id title status workflowStatus workflowStatusLabel severity hazardName incidentTypeName districtName regionName councilName wardName locationDescription reportedAt description latitude longitude allocationsCount tasksCount responseActive } tasks { id title priority status progressPercent dueDate assignedToName } allocations { id resourceName quantityRequested quantityAllocated unit status } updatesCount workflowHistoriesCount } }
